observations: Industrial-looking straight-stitch sewing machine on a stand/table.
Photos show a brand label that appears to read “emel” on the machine body (photo 3 and photo 2).
No clear model number is readable in the photos.
Machine body shows visible wear/dirt/scuffs (especially on stand/table and lower areas).
No close-up of needle area, feed mechanism, belt/pulley condition, or motor/controls.
No photo shows the machine running, stitching, or the motor sound/behavior.

claims.evidence: Machine type/appearance matches an industrial straight-stitch setup in photos 0-3 (needle area not shown clearly, but overall form is consistent).
No country-of-origin marking is readable in the provided photos.
No video/photo shows the motor running or stitching.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No accessories/manual are shown in the photos.

claims.claim: never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: No service history or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Motor/drive may be weak, noisy, or intermittent (seller says smooth running but no proof).
risks.proof: Short video: plug-in start + 2-3 minutes continuous running, plus a close-up of the handwheel/needle movement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as working but unproven condition; if it fails to run smoothly during test, treat as not as described and negotiate down to the lowest comparable.

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories/manual (seller claims all included, but nothing is shown).
risks.proof: Photo/clip laid out: presser feet, bobbins, needles, tools, power cable, and the manual cover/pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete (worst case: accessories/manual not included).

risks.risk: Needle/feed timing or stitch quality may be off (no stitching test shown).
risks.proof: Video of stitching on fabric: straight seam with consistent feed for at least 1 meter; show needle penetration and even stitch formation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified for stitch quality (worst case: needs adjustment).

risks.risk: Condition/wear on stand/table and moving parts may indicate heavy use or rust/dirt inside.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: feed dogs, presser foot area, belt/pulley (if any), and underside/inside near the hook/bobbin case.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of industrial-machine comparables due to visible wear.

risks.risk: Country-of-origin claim (Japanese made) may be incorrect.
risks.proof: Photo of any nameplate/serial plate showing country of manufacture and model/serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price without premium for “Japanese made” (treat as generic industrial straight-stitch).

proof_requests: Video: motor start and continuous running for 2-3 minutes (show needle movement).
Video: stitching test on fabric (straight seam for at least 1 meter).
Photos/laid-out inventory of all accessories and the manual (manual cover + a page showing details).
Close-up of the machine nameplate/serial plate (country of origin + model/serial).
Close-up of needle/feed/hook area and underside/belt/pulley (if applicable).
response.reason: The photos confirm an industrial straight-stitch machine and a brand label that appears to be “emel,” but key value drivers (motor performance, stitch quality, included accessories/manual, and origin) are not verifiable from the provided images.
